tagline.en: Concord to the Canadian border through the Green Mountains
tagline.zh: 自康科德穿越绿山直抵加拿大边境

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.en: I-93 in Bow, New Hampshire, south of Concord
start.zh: 新罕布什尔州鲍，康科德以南，与 I-93 相接

end.en: The Canadian border at Highgate Springs, Vermont
end.zh: 佛蒙特州海盖特斯普林斯的加拿大边境

en: I-89 is the diagonal across northern New England: from Concord, New Hampshire, north-west over the Connecticut River at White River Junction, then up through the centre of Vermont past Randolph, Montpelier and Burlington to the Canadian border at Highgate Springs.

It is a rural Interstate almost end to end. Vermont's two largest population centres, Burlington and the Barre–Montpelier pair, sit on it, but between them the road runs through forest and hill farms, and the exits are far apart. Its highest point is in the town of Brookfield, in the high country of central Vermont.
Functionally it is the Boston-to-Montreal road, and that is not what it was originally meant to be.
zh: I-89 是新英格兰北部的那条对角线：自新罕布什尔州康科德向西北，在白河交汇处跨过康涅狄格河，再穿过佛蒙特州中部，经伦道夫、蒙彼利埃与伯灵顿，直抵海盖特斯普林斯的加拿大边境。
它几乎全程都是乡村州际公路。佛蒙特州最大的两处人口聚集地——伯灵顿，以及巴里与蒙彼利埃这一对城镇——都在线上，但两者之间的道路穿行于森林与山地农场，出口相距很远。全线最高点位于佛蒙特中部高地的布鲁克菲尔德镇。
从功能上说，它是波士顿至蒙特利尔的那条路——而这并不是它最初被设计成的样子。

en: As first drawn under the 1956 act, I-89 was to run from Norwalk, Connecticut, to the Canadian border along the US 7 corridor — up the western side of New England. Within three years that plan was abandoned. Massachusetts wanted a freeway link from Boston to Montreal, and the number was moved to the alignment it has now.

Vermont built first and fastest. The opening section between Montpelier and Middlesex came in November 1960, followed within weeks by Middlesex to Waterbury, and the Burlington-area sections through the early 1960s. The stretch from Swanton to Highgate, reaching the international boundary, opened in 1965. New Hampshire's portions opened mostly in 1967.

The last long piece was in the middle. On 19 November 1970, Governor Deane C. Davis opened 30.5 miles between Bethel and Montpelier — the final stretch between Concord and the Canadian border — with high school bands at Bethel and cider and doughnuts at Randolph. The same governor had just signed Act 250, Vermont's land-use law, partly to keep the new highways from bringing the sprawl that usually followed them.
zh: 按 1956 年法案最初的方案，I-89 本应自康涅狄格州诺沃克沿 US 7 走廊北上至加拿大边境——也就是走新英格兰的西侧。不到三年，这一方案即被放弃：马萨诸塞州希望有一条从波士顿通往蒙特利尔的高速公路，于是这个编号被挪到了今天的线位上。
佛蒙特州动工最早、推进最快。首段位于蒙彼利埃与米德尔塞克斯之间，1960 年 11 月通车；数周后米德尔塞克斯至沃特伯里段跟进；伯灵顿一带各路段则在 1960 年代初陆续建成。自斯旺顿至海盖特、抵达国界的一段于 1965 年通车。新罕布什尔州境内路段多在 1967 年通车。
最后一段长路在中间。1970 年 11 月 19 日，迪恩·C·戴维斯州长为伯特利与蒙彼利埃之间 30.5 英里路段揭幕——这是康科德至加拿大边境之间的最后一段——伯特利有中学乐队助兴，伦道夫备了苹果酒和甜甜圈。同一位州长当时刚签署了佛蒙特州的土地利用法《第 250 号法案》，其用意之一，正是不让新建的公路带来通常随之而来的无序蔓延。

why.en: No public route-wide figure exists. The road was built by two states over roughly two decades as separate contracts, and federal cost accounting was kept for the Interstate System as a whole rather than per route.
why.zh: 无公开的全线数据。这条路由两个州历时约二十年、以多份独立合同建成，而联邦造价核算是针对整个州际公路系统，并非逐条统计。

value.en: 191.11 miles: 130.25 in Vermont and 60.86 in New Hampshire
value.zh: 191.11 英里：佛蒙特州 130.25 英里，新罕布什尔州 60.86 英里

figures.source: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

why.en: Vermont and New Hampshire publish counts by segment. The Burlington approaches carry far more than the rural central Vermont sections, and no route-wide figure is published.
why.zh: 佛蒙特州与新罕布什尔州按路段发布交通量。伯灵顿引道路段的流量远高于佛蒙特中部乡村路段，亦未发布全线数字。

value.en: 28 minutes off the White River Junction to Montpelier trip, which had previously used Route 14 or Route 12 north of Bethel
value.zh: 白河交汇处至蒙彼利埃的行程缩短 28 分钟；此前该行程在伯特利以北须走 Route 14 或 Route 12

conditionFigures.source: Valley News, reporting on the November 1970 opening

timeline.en: The first section opens in Vermont between Montpelier and Middlesex in November.
timeline.zh: 11 月，佛蒙特州蒙彼利埃至米德尔塞克斯的首段通车。

timeline.en: The section from Swanton to Highgate opens, carrying the route to the Canadian border.
timeline.zh: 斯旺顿至海盖特路段通车，本路线抵达加拿大边境。

timeline.en: Most of the New Hampshire portion opens.
timeline.zh: 新罕布什尔州境内大部分路段通车。

timeline.en: 30.5 miles between Bethel and Montpelier open on 19 November, the last stretch between Concord and the border.
timeline.zh: 11 月 19 日，伯特利至蒙彼利埃之间 30.5 英里通车，为康科德至边境之间的最后一段。
